DevOps Engineer salary in the United States

Based on 404 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States is $122,475–$182,440 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $162,140 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $162,140 a year across 404 current postings. The middle 50% is $122,475–$182,440 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

SYSTOLIC: about $265,000 a year (median of 38 listings); Wyetech: about $223,329 a year (median of 3 listings); Gatik AI: about $220,000 a year (median of 2 listings); MetroStar: about $215,000 a year (median of 3 listings); Amazon Web Services, Inc.: about $207,800 a year (median of 2 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

How does remote pay compare with on-site pay?

The listed midpoint median is about $139,050 a year for 8 remote listings and about $121,775 a year for 12 explicitly on-site listings. These are different postings, not controlled estimates of a remote-work premium.

What pay is listed for entry-level and new-grad jobs?

The median listed midpoint is about $216,000 a year from 16 entry-level and new-grad postings with usable pay. Internship listings are excluded from this comparison.
